entries.content: Sold the old bookshelf today. Met the buyer at the coffee shop parking lot on Main St. Took an extra 15 minutes out of my day but the transaction went smoothly. Buyer seemed nice enough but you never really know with strangers from the internet.

Finally sold my old gaming rig yesterday. Used the safe exchange spot at the police station - felt a bit awkward standing there with a PC tower but the buyer showed up on time. He tested it in his car for a few minutes before paying. Whole thing took longer than I wanted but at least everything went fine.
